evidence_inputs: The reviewed run's manifest declares no baseline_suite or after_suite: its gate is an analysis script, not a test suite. added_failure_count is therefore 0 over an empty failure set rather than a measured zero, and the gate log docs/evidence/fragments/rotate-to-deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017/deepseek-1017-on-our-work.log ends with a bare EXIT=0 line.

Figure rendered and inspected by this reviewer, not taken from the worker's account: convert -density 100 on the committed differences.svg produced a 1400x880 PNG at /tmp/reckon-crew-scratch/r-20261026T222428106819-review-of-deepseek-1017-on-our-work-d9fecb4dd263/render/head.png. Three panels, twelve row labels, per-panel axis label and unit, and the bottom note are all legible; no label overlaps another or is clipped at the canvas edge; only the left and bottom spines are drawn.

Negative control reproduced independently: the guard predicate at deepseek-1017-on-our-work.py:507-512 was run over both arms in this review's scratch tree. Committed head figure -> text_elements=0 font_refs=0 exit=0. The figure as committed at 987c54c1 (git show 987c54c1:...differences.svg) -> text_elements=37 font_refs=1 exit=1. Both counts match the manifest's negative_control_note exactly.

The repair changed no number: diffing the log committed at 987c54c1 against the one committed at d9fecb4d shows every metric, interval and control line identical; only the revision header, the command line, three unbounded context counts (2,867 -> 2,869 ledger records, 2,506 -> 2,934 request rows, 11,313 -> 11,319 run ids) and the added results-written line differ. That is the expected behaviour of a window-bounded analysis as the ledgers grow.

The headline numbers reconcile between the three surfaces: log :41 first_attempt_pass diff 0.174845 [0.064777, 0.290653], document table :83 +0.175 [+0.065, +0.291], fragment html result paragraph the same pair plus the restricted +0.175 [+0.065, +0.285].

An earlier independent review of this run at 987c54c1 is stored beside this one; its four non-blocking findings about the log's revision header, the 2,865 record count, the non-gating moved-boundary control and the bootstrap method sentence are all still present at d9fecb4d, and are re-emitted here rather than assumed carried.

findings.text: The log's '# revision: 987c54c1' header names the previous commit while the code that produced the log is the d9fecb4d blob: the '# command:' line at :4 carries ANALYSIS_JSON and FIGURE_PNG and the body at :85 prints '# results written to ...', both of which exist only after d9fecb4d. A reader checking provenance by the header concludes the log predates the code, which is the second occurrence of this defect in this node (the 987c54c1 log named 7d09b85b); the fix is to commit the script before running the gate, not to relabel the header.

The document says the implement/clive pair 'selects 2,865 records across all history'; the committed log prints 2,869 at :10 (it printed 2,867 when the document was written). The number is context rather than a reported metric, but it is one of the document's own figures that its script no longer reproduces, and the repair regenerated the log without reconciling it.

The moved-boundary control's results are computed into moved_ok and moved_no_change and printed, but verdict_from at :376-377 is gated only on control_ok (the positive control) and the call site at :677 passes only control_ok. A negative control that had reported a detectable difference would still have emitted 'better'; the control passed on this run, so the recorded output is right, but the instrument does not enforce it.

The verdict line quotes first_attempt_pass +0.175 [0.065, 0.285], the restricted interval, while the metrics block at :41 prints diff 0.174845 [0.064777, 0.290653] for the same metric forty lines earlier, and the document reports the second as +0.175 [+0.065, +0.291]. Both readings are correct because verdict_from at :385 prefers the restricted estimate, but the log never says which interval its verdict line repeats, so a reader comparing the two lines in one file sees a 0.006 discrepancy with no explanation.

The section says 'Each estimate carries a 95% bootstrap interval over runs (2,000 resamples)', but the failed-or-aborted request row at :100 is a Wilson interval over 141,782 request rows, not a bootstrap over runs; deepseek-1017-on-our-work.py substitutes the closed-form interval above 20,000 rows. The method sentence overstates what the bootstrap covers for one row of the table it introduces.

No product source and no test file changed.

item_verdicts.goal: The goal is a research document comparing local-lane implement runs either side of the 2026-10-23T20:14:30Z swap and returning one of four verdicts with intervals; docs/research/deepseek-1017-on-our-work.html:78-101 gives both windows (300 analysed / 97 analysed) with twelve metrics and 95% intervals and :172-175 states the verdict 'Better', so the landed change does what the goal states.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it records status complete, commits 7d09b85b / 987c54c1 / d9fecb4d, the analysis script as its gate with its log path, the before/after counts, the positive control, the moved-boundary control, the font-independence negative control with both arms' counts, and the unmeasured cached-token column.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Six paths were granted under docs/research, docs/figures and docs/evidence/fragments/rotate-to-deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017; `git diff --numstat f7631d98 d9fecb4d` lists five files and every one is inside a declared path (the docs/figures/deepseek-1017-on-our-work grant went unused, which is not a violation).

justifications.durability: deepseek-1017-on-our-work.py:507-512 raises when the saved SVG still contains '<text' or 'font-family', which is a genuine fail-on-regression guard and not a value compared against itself, since it reads the written file rather than the arguments; the metrics and window-filter path still has no test that reddens, so the node's numbers rest on a re-run against a committed log.
justifications.evidence: deepseek-1017-on-our-work.log:20-88 records every metric, interval and control and ends EXIT=0, and I re-ran the write_figure guard's own predicate over both arms with the result the manifest claims (head text_elements=0 font_refs=0 exit=0; the 987c54c1 figure text_elements=37 font_refs=1 exit=1); the log's revision header at :1 is nonetheless wrong, naming 987c54c1 while the command line it carries is d9fecb4d-only.
justifications.fit: The rewrite follows the repository's figure idiom by applying the shared data-ink sheet with a local fallback at deepseek-1017-on-our-work.py:411-424, despines both panels and labels units directly, and adds no plan or stage identifier in any symbol or path.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/research/deepseek-1017-on-our-work.html:172-175 returns 'Better' with the interval that carries it, and the figure at docs/figures/rotate-to-deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017/deepseek-1017-on-our-work/differences.svg now renders its three panel titles, twelve row labels, per-panel units and note from vector paths.
justifications.reuse: A capability search over imas_ambix/, scripts/ and docs/evidence/ for a shared figure style or save helper found none: scripts/plot_serving_accelerator_figures.py:27-42 sets its own rcParams inline and picks svg.fonttype 'none', so the font-independence guard is the first owner of that capability rather than a fork of one.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every path in `git diff --numstat f7631d98 d9fecb4d` is inside the node's declared write paths and the repair commit adds nothing the goal does not imply.
